text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-p-i-e-d the s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e of a-l-r-e-a-d-y e-n-r-o-l-l-e-d p-l-a-t-e-s i-n-t-o the i-m-a-g-e a-n-a-l-y-s-t s-w-e-p-d-s and the t-r-a-c-e o-n f-i-l-e s-h-o-w-s the m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a s-t-a-m-p of the o-p-e-r-a-t-o-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t with the c-h-e-c-k n-o-t p-e-r-f-o-r-m-e-d on the a-d-m-i-n a-u-d-i-t l-o-g.
2) the m-e-t-h-o-d u-s-e-d a t-r-a-i-n-i-n-g p-a-i-r-s of l-a-b-e-l-l-e-d s-w-i-p-e-s to p-r-o-d-u-c-e a s-y-n-t-h-e-t-i-c m-a-t-c-h f-o-r the e-x-o-r-b-i-t 021 and the t-r-a-c-e o-n f-i-l-e l-i-s-t-s the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e with the c-h-e-c-k n-o-t p-e-r-f-o-r-m-e-d on the v-e-r-s-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l of the a-c-c-e-s-s d-e-s-k.
3) the r-e-p-o-r-t n-o-t-e-s the t-r-y to r-o-u-t-e the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y t-h-r-o-u-g-h a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e p-e-r-s-o-n's b-a-d-g-e and the t-r-a-c-e o-n f-i-l-e s-h-o-w-s the g-a-t-e-w-a-y t-o-k-e-n r-e-u-s-e in the s-y-s-t-e-m l-o-g-s with the c-h-e-c-k n-o-t p-e-r-f-o-r-m-e-d on the s-e-s-s-i-o-n b-i-n-d-i-n-g.
4) the l-o-g d-e-b-r-i-e-f s-t-a-t-e-s the a-t-t-e-m-p-t to f-a-l-s-i-f-y the t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-s in the a-c-c-e-s-s r-e-c-o-r-d-s and the t-r-a-c-e o-n f-i-l-e s-h-o-w-s the h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e c-l-o-c-k d-r-i-f-t f-l-a-g with the c-h-e-c-k n-o-t p-e-r-f-o-r-m-e-d on the s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the c-l-o-s-u-r-e n-o-t-e-s the r-e-c-o-v-e-r-y of the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t d-a-t-a f-r-o-m the s-h-a-d-o-w d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e and the t-r-a-c-e o-n f-i-l-e s-h-o-w-s the c-h-a-l-l-e-n-g-e r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e d-i-s-c-a-r-d with the c-h-e-c-k n-o-t p-e-r-f-o-r-m-e-d on the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y c-o-r-r-o-b-o-r-a-t-i-o-n.
